content:
pair_ao:
  name: Pair AO
  description: Enroll mTLS with a one-time Ada enroll token.
  fields:
    enroll_token:
      required: true
      example: "one-time-token"
      selector:
        text:
    client_name:
      required: false
      example: "comstar-ha"
      selector:
        text:

clear_certs:
  name: Clear local certs
  description: Delete local mTLS PEMs (does not revoke on AO).

probe:
  name: Probe AO
  description: GET engine /health with client certificate.

refresh_status:
  name: Refresh status
  description: Re-inspect pairing and update diagnostic entities.

set_api_token:
  name: Set API token
  description: Rotate minted Bearer token (appId comstar-ha).
  fields:
    api_token:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:

reset_session:
  name: Reset session
  description: Stop Reach session and clear remote overlay.

refresh_overlay:
  name: Refresh overlay
  description: Re-register stock+user catalogs on the live Reach session.

announce:
  name: Announce
  description: Proactive spoken message via AO TTS when available.
  fields:
    message:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:

direct_agent:
  name: Direct agent
  description: Run a client.* agent via Reach.
  fields:
    text:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    agent_id:
      required: false
      example: "client.voice_responder"
      selector:
        text:
    mcp_provider_ids:
      required: false
      selector:
        object:

run_harness:
  name: Run harness
  description: Best-effort harness pack execution (records path for operator follow-up).
  fields:
    harness_id:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:

catalog_list:
  name: Catalog list
  fields:
    kind:
      required: true
      selector:
        select:
          options:
            - agent_providers
            - mcp_providers
            - agent_skills
            - agent_harnesses
            - harnesses

catalog_get:
  name: Catalog get
  fields:
    kind:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    id:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:

catalog_upsert:
  name: Catalog upsert
  fields:
    kind:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    id:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    yaml:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
          multiline: true

catalog_delete:
  name: Catalog delete
  fields:
    kind:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    id:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:

catalog_enable:
  name: Catalog enable
  fields:
    kind:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    id:
      required: true
      selector:
        text:
    enabled:
      required: true
      selector:
        boolean:
